disable_thinking.engine: This deployment does not serve Chat through an engine that forwards chat_template_kwargs, so no chat-template switch can take effect here. Add the parameter under Extra Parameters only if the engine accepts it, for example {{examples}}.
disable_thinking.model: The Playground has not confirmed which chat_template_kwargs field stops thinking for this model, so it does not send one the chat template might ignore. Add the parameter yourself under Extra Parameters, for example {{examples}}.

include_usage.label: Report usage (include_usage)
include_usage.description: Return prompt and completion token counts in the last chunk, for exact metrics once the reply ends.

continuous_usage_stats.label: Usage on every chunk (continuous_usage_stats)
continuous_usage_stats.description: Put the running token counts on every chunk so speed metrics update while the reply streams (vLLM, SGLang). Turn it off if the endpoint rejects it; metrics then estimate tokens from chunks.
